summary: Discussion-led signals: Anthropic/OpenAI agent escape stories and a Google MCP SSRF CVE dominate; operator tips and several infra primitives (durable storage, chaos testing, local sandboxes) show up in social threads. | Official-vendor updates: Anthropic Opus 5 launch and product stories, OpenAI/GPT‑5.6 pricing signals via AWS, Mistral agent tooling, multiple vendors adding sandboxes and agent SDK integrations. | GitHub OSS snapshot: rising popularity of Vercel agent tooling and several agent orchestration/sandbox primitives (Omnigent, Codeman, mitos). Mostly repo-first signals; social/operator reports missing. | Package-registry signals show growing agent infra: official vendor CLIs (OpenAI Codex, Amazon ECS agent), multiple VS Code agent extensions for persistent memory/workflows, and a cluster of sandbox/eval/security primitives needing corroboration.
